newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March T-bond posts sharp losses before data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March T-bond posts sharp losses before data.

text.p: Dec 5 - U.S. March T-bonds collapsed to 3-week low in heavy trading, on profit-taking ahead of jobs report. Many said to be worried the risk is for a bond-bearish number Friday. Average forecast for 179,000 Nov jobs, 5.2 percent unemployment rate. Some traders point to The Liscio Report, which forecasts reading of 215,000 jobs. Some peg support at 112-00.
